description: Set the internal hourly COST rate for one member of your organization (used for profit/margin reporting). The organization is fixed by your context - never pass an organization id. You cannot set your own cost rate. The rate value is never echoed back.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR). Defaults to USD.

effective_from.description: Optional date this rate takes effect (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

effective_to.description: Optional date this rate stops applying (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for an open-ended rate.

hourly_rate.description: The hourly cost rate, a positive number (required).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

user_id.description: Id (or Firebase UID) of the member whose cost rate is being set (required). Must be a member of your organization; cannot be yourself.

name: set_user_cost_rate
